title: Smokin' Hot
coverAlt: Smokin' Hot e-shop home page on a desktop browser and a phone: dark page with a red headline and the brand badge.
brief: The client produces and sells hot pepper sauces in Serbia and needed a website with a shop, with payment on delivery.
summary: E-shop for a Serbian hot-sauce brand: 10 products, 6 languages, payment on delivery.

gallery.title: Problem
gallery.alt: Smokin' Hot board 2, A shop that looks as loud as the sauce: the brief, who the shop is for, and the home page opening on the brand, the offer and one action.
gallery.caption: The home page opens on the brand, the offer and one clear action, then walks down the heat scale.

gallery.title: Key flow
gallery.alt: Smokin' Hot board 3, Browse, product, cart: product card, product page with heat meter, and cart summary on phone screens.
gallery.caption:
Browse: each card carries its heat level as a coloured badge, a price in orange and one red action.
Product: the heat meter comes first, then name, price and quantity.
Cart: delivery cost, free-delivery hint and total sit above a single red 'Poruci' action.

gallery.title: Responsive
gallery.alt: Smokin' Hot board 4, One layout, two proportions: the home page and a product page at desktop 1440 and mobile 390.
gallery.caption:
Desktop, 1440: headline and brand badge sit side by side.
Mobile, 390: the same content stacks into one column and the two buttons stack.
Desktop product page: image left, level meter, price and add button right.
Mobile: image first, then the same stack in one column.

gallery.title: Design system
gallery.alt: Smokin' Hot board 5, Dark base, hot accents: colour swatches with roles, type samples, buttons, status pill and heat scale.
gallery.caption:
Colour roles: base, surface, red (primary action), ember (prices, active nav), acid yellow (outline action, badges), mild heat level 1, cream text.
Headlines: Inter Black, uppercase, tight tracking, in cream and red.
Body and labels: Inter regular, with Serbian diacritics.
Primary: solid red with a hard offset shadow. Secondary: yellow outline.
Status pill: small, letter-spaced, one glowing dot.
Heat scale: four numbered dots, lime to red, reused across the site.
Card actions: a quiet dark button beside the red one.

gallery.title: Details
gallery.alt: Smokin' Hot board 6, Small parts, made carefully: heat scale, product card, mobile language menu, language switch and order summary.
gallery.caption:
Heat scale: four cards, one colour bar per level, and the hottest sauce framed in red.
Product card: level chip, price and two actions of clear rank.
On mobile the language list sits in the full-screen menu, below the cart link.
Language switch: a globe and two letters open a list of six, the current one ticked.
Order summary: total in orange, one red action, delivery terms in a quiet box.

gallery.title: Outcome
gallery.alt: Smokin' Hot board 7, outcome: 10 products, 6 languages, payment on delivery, and the front-end tools.
gallery.caption:
Products: 10.
Languages: Serbian, English, Russian, Romanian, Hungarian, German.
Payment: cash on delivery.
Tools: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.

problem: The brief asked for something attractive, interactive and unmistakably 'rock and roll': a dark base with red, ember orange and acid yellow accents.
users: Customers across Serbia, shopping in Serbian, with English, Russian, Romanian, Hungarian and German available.
flow: Browse: each card carries its heat level as a coloured badge, a price in orange and one red action.
Product: the heat meter comes first, then name, price and quantity.
Cart: delivery cost, free-delivery hint and total sit above a single red 'Poruci' action.
